# New Falcon Furniture

> Family-run custom furniture manufacturer in Bangalore, factory-direct since 2004. Founded by Rizwan Pasha. Serving all Bengaluru localities from our Arekere workshop.

## About

New Falcon Furniture is a custom furniture manufacturer operating factory-direct from Arekere, Bannerghatta Road, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560076. Founded in 2004 by Rizwan Pasha, we specialize in handcrafted sofas, modular beds, modular kitchens, custom wardrobes, dining sets, and office furniture. Rated 4.9/5 by 296+ Google reviews.

## Services

- **Custom Sofas**: Handcrafted 3-seater sofas starting ₹15,000, 50+ fabric options, 2-3 week delivery
- **Modular Beds**: Space-saving storage beds with premium wood finishes
- **Modular Kitchens**: End-to-end design, manufacturing and installation, 3-year warranty
- **Custom Wardrobes**: Sliding and hinged wardrobes for Indian homes
- **Dining Sets**: 4-seater to 8-seater tables in wood, metal, or composite finishes
- **Office Furniture**: Ergonomic workstations and desks for home offices and startups

## Service Areas

Arekere, HSR Layout, Koramangala, JP Nagar, BTM Layout, Bannerghatta Road, Jayanagar, Basavanagudi, Whitefield, Marathahalli, Electronic City, Sarjapur Road — and all Bengaluru localities.
